summary: No open repository table pairs brain, heart and liver weight with body weight across the birth-to-adult span. Body mass by age is open (NHANES); brain volume by age is derivable from open MRI (OpenNeuro) but not mass, and the pediatric NIH series has moved behind NDA access control; the only open organ-weight-with-body-weight table found is an adult heart-weight autopsy set (Zenodo 4300167). The classical sources (Vierordt, Boyd, Coppoletta & Wolbach, Dekaban & Sadowsky) are in paper tables, not repositories; lion and dogfish series were not found.
next_step: Transcribe an age-by-organ-weight reference table (e.g. Coppoletta & Wolbach 1933 for 0–12 y, Dekaban & Sadowsky 1978 for brain 0–86 y) into one CSV with body weight, then pair with NHANES for denominators; search literature for a non-human series.
obstacles_confirmed: MRI volume and autopsy weight are not the same quantity, and body mass is often not in the imaging file.
The lion and dogfish series are not in these human-centered archives.
pediatricmri.nih.gov no longer responds; the collection is access-controlled in NDA.
